TASK-1952 slice plan. S1 = #2790, already shipped.
S2 = PR #2813 (open, CI pending): TASK-1989, 2036, 2037, BUG-2016, BUG-2154, TASK-2031/2034 (contained boundary and launch).
S3: store commit + hooks: TASK-1652/2009 (child_store_commit pathspec), TASK-1759 (store_hooks g+w), BUG-2117 (commit-msg/prepare-commit-msg templates), TASK-1643 (guardrails NO_SLOT scan).
S4: host git: TASK-1924 (credential helper scope per host), TASK-1943 (quoted porcelain dedupe, collect_branch_facts test, OVERVIEW line), BUG-1992 (store-git guard shapes, git_backend.rs:621 route), TASK-1926 (bug_1985 guard scope), TASK-1942 (host_git_command spawns; reply below if you want it held for the TOCTOU security call).
S5: guard ratchets: TASK-2001 (remote-credentials ratchet), TASK-1976 (split/aliased GRANT_ENV reads), TASK-1977 (named test exemption).
S6: launchers: TASK-1761, TASK-1770, TASK-1798, TASK-1781. This slice goes alone if it touches a gate file. The last PR carries the bare (TASK-1952).
No code change, reason given in the PR body: TASK-1642 (the wording was in an old PR body), TASK-1641 (needs an operator real-claude run).
